objections.claim: The E2 first-deployment transition is internally unsatisfiable. Every genesis-class record must carry `old_verifier_closure_digest` equal to the LIVE protected `VERIFIER_CLOSURE_DIGEST`, but genesis explicitly omits that variable and E2 advances it only after the controller-authorized merge. No canonical absent-state value is defined. Therefore the controller cannot validate E2's full old/new tuple without either pre-provisioning the new digest—which the approach expressly refuses—or weakening predecessor equality. Provision the pre-E2 verifier closure digest as the live genesis value (without executing it as authority), then bind E2's proposed digest as `new_verifier_closure_digest` and advance the variable only after merge; add regressions for missing, pre-provisioned-new, and correct-old values.
